fire.exit_desc_1: In a fire emergency, heavy smoke reduces visibility to zero in under 30 seconds. Panic causes confusion — knowing your exit routes beforehand saves critical seconds.
fire.exit_desc_2: Never rely on a single exit path. If flames or smoke block your primary route, you must immediately pivot to your pre-identified secondary emergency path.
fire.exit_title_3: Never Use Elevators in a Fire
fire.exit_desc_3: Elevator shafts act as natural chimneys drawing superheated toxic gases. Power failure can strand the car between burning floors. Always use designated fire stairwells.
fire.place_desc: Point your tablet at the floor or table. Tap the green button below (or tap anywhere on screen) to place the extinguisher.
fire.place_btn: 🎯 TAP TO PLACE EXTINGUISHER ON FLOOR
fire.pass_pull_desc: Tap anywhere to select the pin, then swipe right to pull it out.
fire.pass_pull_badge_btn: 👉 SWIPE RIGHT OR TAP TO PULL PIN
fire.pass_aim_title: A — Aim at Base of Fire
fire.pass_aim_desc: Point your device directly at the base of the fire. Hold steady for 0.8 seconds.
fire.pass_squeeze_desc: Press and hold the button below for 1.5 seconds to discharge the extinguisher.
fire.pass_sweep_desc: Move your device left and right to sweep the fire base. Cover at least 75% of the fire width.
fire.evac_desc_1: Sounding the building alarm immediately alerts everyone before heat spreads. Never delay evacuation to gather personal belongings or tools.
fire.evac_desc_2: Proceed directly to your designated external assembly area. Immediate headcount verification ensures rescuers know if anyone is trapped inside.
fire.evac_desc_3: After using the extinguisher, you must evacuate. Select the safest option:

gas.step1_desc_1: Confined spaces (tanks, sumps, silos, underground pits) trap invisible lethal gases like H₂S, methane, or CO. Low oxygen (<19.5%) causes sudden loss of consciousness without warning.
gas.step1_desc_2: Never enter without a signed Confined Space Entry Permit. Calibrated gas detectors must sample the atmosphere at top (light gases), middle, and bottom (heavy gases) levels before entry.
gas.step2_desc_1: In oxygen-deficient (<19.5% O₂) or unknown toxic gas atmospheres, only a Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA) provides clean air. Cloth or dust masks offer zero protection against gases.
gas.step2_desc_2: A multi-gas monitor must continuously alert the entrant to rising toxic levels. A full-body harness and retrieval lifeline allow non-entry rescue if a worker collapses inside.
gas.step3_desc_1: The safety attendant (buddy) remains stationed strictly outside the entrance opening. Over 60% of confined space fatalities are would-be rescuers entering without protection.
gas.step3_desc_2: The attendant maintains unbroken visual or radio communication at fixed intervals. If an entrant becomes unresponsive, the attendant immediately initiates external winch retrieval and summons emergency response.
gas.test_ready_desc: You will now execute the 3 critical protocol steps without educational hints. Demonstrate proper hazard recognition, PPE selection, and buddy communication.
gas.step1_action_desc: Identify marked toxic/confined gas perimeter in AR space. Confirm you recognize the hazard boundary.
gas.step2_action_desc: Select all required PPE for hazardous gas entry (select all that apply):
gas.step3_action_desc: What is the safety attendant role outside the confined opening?
gas.step1_hint: Hint: Low oxygen (<19.5%) and toxic gases (H₂S, methane) trap in confined pits. Verify hazard boundary before entry.
gas.step2_hint: Hint: Only SCBA provides clean breathable air in toxic or low-oxygen atmospheres. Cloth or dust masks offer zero protection.
gas.step3_hint: Hint: The standby buddy must remain outside with a continuous lifeline. Never enter to attempt unequipped rescue.

fire_extinguisher.name: Fire Extinguisher
fire_extinguisher.purpose: Puts out a small fire before it spreads. Aim at the base of the flames.

pressure_gauge.label: Pressure Gauge
pressure_gauge.desc: The needle must sit in the green band. In the red, the cylinder will not discharge.

handle.label: Handle / Lever
handle.desc: Squeeze to discharge. Release to stop.

safety_pin.label: Safety Pin
safety_pin.desc: Pull this out first. The lever will not move until it is removed.

valve_block.label: Valve Block
valve_block.desc: Holds the pressure in. Never strike it or loosen it.

hose.label: Hose
hose.desc: Carries the powder from the cylinder to the nozzle. Check it for cracks.

nozzle.label: Nozzle
nozzle.desc: Point this at the base of the fire, not at the flames.

ppe_kit.name: PPE Kit
ppe_kit.purpose: The protective clothing worn before entering a fire or hot work area.

safety_goggles.label: Safety Goggles
safety_goggles.desc: Shield the eyes from smoke, sparks and flying debris.

high_vis_vest.label: High-Visibility Vest
high_vis_vest.desc: Reflective strips let rescuers find you in heavy smoke.

flame_resistant_coverall.label: Flame-Resistant Coverall
flame_resistant_coverall.desc: Does not melt onto skin. Ordinary synthetic clothing does.

safety_gloves.label: Safety Gloves
safety_gloves.desc: Protect the hands from hot metal and from the extinguisher's cold horn.

safety_helmet.name: Safety Helmet
safety_helmet.purpose: Protects the head from falling rock, tools and impact. Wear it underground at all times.

outer_shell.label: Outer Shell
outer_shell.desc: Spreads the force of an impact. Replace it after any hard blow.

brim.label: Brim
brim.desc: Keeps falling dust and water off the face.

suspension_harness.label: Suspension Harness
suspension_harness.desc: The inner cradle. It holds a gap between shell and skull — never remove it.

chin_strap.label: Chin Strap
chin_strap.desc: Keeps the helmet on your head when you bend or fall. Fasten it every time.

safety_shoes.name: Safety Shoes
safety_shoes.purpose: Protect the feet from falling loads, sharp scrap and slippery ground.

ankle_collar.label: Ankle Collar
ankle_collar.desc: Supports the ankle on uneven mine floors.

steel_toe_cap.label: Steel Toe Cap
steel_toe_cap.desc: Takes the weight of a dropped load off your toes.

penetration_resistant_midsole.label: Penetration-Resistant Midsole
penetration_resistant_midsole.desc: Stops nails and sharp scrap coming up through the sole.

anti_slip_sole.label: Anti-Slip Sole
anti_slip_sole.desc: Grips wet and oily floors. Check the tread is not worn smooth.

multi_gas_detector.name: Multi-Gas Detector
multi_gas_detector.purpose: Reads the air before you enter. It finds gases you cannot smell.

alarm_indicator.label: Alarm Indicator
alarm_indicator.desc: Flashes and sounds when gas rises or oxygen falls. Leave at once.

display_screen.label: Display Screen
display_screen.desc: Shows the live reading for each gas.

sensor_intake.label: Sensor Intake
sensor_intake.desc: Air enters here. Never cover it with a hand or a glove.

control_buttons.label: Control Buttons
control_buttons.desc: Power on, move through the readings, and confirm. Test before every shift.

scba.name: SCBA / Breathing Apparatus
scba.purpose: Supplies clean air from a cylinder. The only protection in a toxic or low-oxygen space.

cylinder_valve.label: Cylinder Valve
cylinder_valve.desc: Open it fully before entry and check the gauge reads full.

face_mask.label: Face Mask
face_mask.desc: Must seal against the skin. A beard breaks the seal.

air_cylinder.label: Air Cylinder
air_cylinder.desc: Holds your air supply. Know how many minutes it gives you.

pressure_regulator.label: Pressure Regulator
pressure_regulator.desc: Steps the cylinder pressure down to air you can breathe.

safety_harness.name: Safety Harness & Lifeline
safety_harness.purpose: Lets the attendant pull you out of a confined space without entering it.

dorsal_d_ring.label: Dorsal D-Ring
dorsal_d_ring.desc: The lifeline attaches here, between the shoulder blades.

chest_strap.label: Chest Strap
chest_strap.desc: Keeps the shoulder straps from sliding off.

leg_straps.label: Leg Straps
leg_straps.desc: Carry your weight during a rescue. Snug, about two fingers of slack.

lifeline.label: Lifeline
lifeline.desc: Runs to the winch outside. It stays attached the whole time you are inside.
